title: Anyone burns a victim's per-signer relay budget by replaying the victim's already-used create/accept authorization
One-source football questions: every foreign proposal is "unconfirmed", last-call disputes drain the bond float to an attacker, then a wrong proposal is only paged
OUTCOME settle pass has no wait back-off: 500 rows on a non-final question hide every later OUTCOME row
Release user to root and signature-gate bypass: root runs verify-commit in the release user's clone with safe.directory=* and honours its gpg.ssh.program
Anyone with an intent UUID (visible in group chats) rewrites its escrowId/sender and can bind the owner's notifications to another address
R3-L1 residual: build/escrow/mine/question,/q,/readyz have no read budget; /stats/users caches per since value
verifyBuildAnswer checks only internal consistency, not amount/recipient/referee vs what the user asked; a referee field overrides the typed referee shown in the preview
Waits and failures share one back-off counter: one failed send after a market-closed hold parks the row 6 h
The release user can make root read any file and publish it as a public GitHub Release body
Created-row state read at latest block, not the log's block; a lagging RPC node could store zeros that are never corrected
A rescheduled fixture may resolve instead of VOID (provider behaviour unverified)
Resolver tick has no time budget; disputes go out only after every source read
Decision typehash does not name the signer (bound only through per-signer nonce and isValid); no ERC-6492 for undeployed smart accounts
PostDeployCheck reads expectations from the JSON the deploy wrote, no bytecode compare, no handed-over mode; real-chain deploy JSON lacks tx hashes

Server-signed cherry-picks/reverts failed the owner-only allowed_signers gate (fail-safe PAUSE); changed by install.sh adding the server key, which opened supply-chain|app/scripts/release/install.sh|server-key-in-allowed-signers
bun audit at 4318745: app 1 high (zod 3.25.76, 1 MB body cap), contracts 1 high (dev-only solc tmp); hono, drizzle, trpc bumped; none reachable
M-4 fix residual: rgit honours a .git/info/grafts file the release user plants, so the descendant and on-main checks can be forged and an older owner-signed revision deployed (downgrade)
M-3 residual: ~30k paid earlier-expiring escrows kept un-backed-off could delay (not starve) an OUTCOME settle; anyone can settle
FeeRouter.sweep has no owner check, so anyone paying gas can make the admin monitor post a Swept alert; funds only move to fixed recipients

Gamma list endpoint /markets?slug= omits CLOSED markets: every resolved Polymarket question read pending forever, OUTCOME payments only refunded at expiry (missed by earlier runs; stubs answered any URL); fixed by /markets/slug/<slug>, checked live
The Odds API scores daysFrom<=3; fixed in eb6d339 (first final read per provider kept). Residual: no successful read at all for 3 days (48 h resolver-unresolved alert); the fix itself has L-8
fixed in 0103f12: /readyz reports when the relayer is not the resolver's question creator (app/src/ops/health.ts)
fixed in 772df77 (cursor advances only after delivery); noise residual: a held cursor re-alerts claimed causes for ~30 min
Comment says feeFor changes only by a timelocked call; setFees is instant (cache feeds previews only; build reads fresh; a stale-fee signature fails closed)

Origin accepts any Cloudflare IP: a request routed through the attacker's own Cloudflare zone/Worker can choose cf-ipcountry (courtesy geo gate only; testnet co-host template); close with authenticated origin pulls
Nonce guard reads the operator-declared DEPLOYER, not the --account that signs; DRYRUN_COMMIT is self-declared: both guards are advisory

Anyone proposes at earliestResolve and disputes their own proposal: the question goes to the panel at zero bond cost (both bonds come back whatever the panel says), the honest service is locked out, payment delayed up to 72 h, VOID if the panel is silent

install.sh adds the release user's own signing key to the allowed_signers root uses: an unsigned queued commit is cherry-picked and re-signed, and any code running as ifso-release can sign and deploy any commit (owner-signature gate off)

L-7 fix keeps a provider's FIRST final read, so after a provider correction and a later pending read the superseded result returns: conflict and no proposal (refund at expiry), or a correct foreign proposal classed contradicted and disputed
Intent owner check compares a typed sender: anyone with the intent id and the owner's address rewrites params/escrowId, so the owner's submit no longer matches (bookkeeping and notifications only)
verifyBuildAnswer does not check refundTo/altRefundTo, op/mode, expiry, acceptBy, stock token or outcome key/mask: a compromised server can get a refund-to-attacker payment signed (L-3 residual)
Root reads release-user-owned PAUSE and alerts.log with head/tail, following symlinks: the release user can make an operator's sudo status print root-only env files
Semgrep exact-match gate fails at 4318745: 4 new hits (list-argv subprocess, fixed-config urlopen; triaged benign) and 1 stale line; CI semgrep job red
The app CI job installs no Foundry, so the 21 anvil-gated app test files are skipped in CI (they ran in this audit and run in the server gate)

Testnet deployment is live and Sourcify-matched but uncommitted; README says testnet not deployed; the manifest's resolverCreator is the deploy-time key, so PostDeployCheck fails until the live creator is pinned
acceptBy <= closeTime and earliestResolve >= closeTime allow an accept and a proposal in the same second; creator is the trusted relayer
Relay budgets are per /64 and per signer only; many /64s (a free /48) toggling refund addresses daily could drain relayer gas; needs measured gas vs fee
Odds API /scores polled every tick per open question with no quota tracking; exhaustion reads as pending
Release user holds a write deploy key; Vercel builds web/ from private main with no signature gate unless GitHub branch protection requires signed commits (not checkable from the repo)

Root trusts refs/remotes/origin/main of the release user's own clone (fetched with that user's config, or set by update-ref), so the 'on private main' check is advisory: any commit on any GitHub branch that passes the signature and descendant checks can be deployed (found by the independent check)
